title: Agent bridge follow-ups: event stream/watch mode and packaged-Tauri transport
description: Post-MVP follow-ups from docs/19-agent-interface.md §MVP scope (Out). Do not start until 0613/0614/0615 are done. (1) Event subscriptions: editor pushes doc-changed (with rev), selection-changed, and playhead notifications to subscribed clients; flash-agent watch streams them as JSON lines. (2) Packaged-Tauri transport: a small WS server in apps/desktop/src-tauri speaking the same @flash/agent-protocol so the bridge works without the Vite dev server; editor client and CLI take a URL so nothing else changes. (3) Optional: multi-editor session routing (named sessions, CLI --session flag). Split into separate tasks if scope grows.
